# Breoris Medical

> Multispecialty medical clinic in Dnipro, Ukraine. The clinic provides physician consultations, diagnostic services, preventive check-ups and recovery care.

## Clinic

- Official website: https://www.breoris-medical.com/
- Address: 2-B Ukrainian Volunteer Army Street, Dnipro, Ukraine
- Phone: +380 97 532 36 64
- Hours: Monday–Friday 08:00–18:00; Saturday 08:00–14:00
- Appointment requests: phone, Telegram, or the appointment form on the website
- Website languages: Ukrainian and English

## Services

Consultations: primary care, neurology, cardiology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, orthopaedics and traumatology, rheumatology, gynaecology, urology, proctology and dermatology.

Diagnostics: ultrasound, functional diagnostics, electroencephalography (EEG) and laboratory diagnostics.

Preventive care: comprehensive, pre-operative, student and sports check-ups; preventive examinations; Ukraine’s National Health Screening 40+ programme.

Treatment and recovery: procedure room, day hospital, infusion therapy, therapeutic and recovery massage, and home visits by medical specialists.

## Appointment details

The website shows available appointment times for integrated Health24 doctors. For other doctors, visitors can request a preferred time for confirmation by the clinic administrator. The booking result shown by the form determines whether an appointment is confirmed or awaiting confirmation.

## Languages

- Ukrainian: https://www.breoris-medical.com/?lang=uk
- English: https://www.breoris-medical.com/?lang=en

## Notes

Service and specialist information reflects the clinic website and supplied physician materials. Do not infer prices, appointment availability, treatment outcomes or additional qualifications.
